main.description: Which of this space's members may see which rooms of the space it federates with. One record per origin space, written to the receiving space's repo — the receiving space's admins are the ones who decide it. Each entry is capped by the matching entry in the origin space's `space.roomy.federation.grant` record, so on its own this record grants nothing.

originSpace.description: The space being federated with. The same DID the record key names.

receiver.description: The grants, one per room and grantee.

room.description: The room: the record key of a `space.roomy.space.room` record in the origin space.

grantee.description: The account or role the grant names, or this space itself for a grant to all of its members.
